title: Fleet
summary: A known inventory is partitioned into independent units.
useWhen: Units and ownership are known before launch.
Independent work exceeds its aggregation overhead.
avoidWhen: Workers edit the same shared files.
contract: Define stable IDs and aggregation before fan-out.
Preserve missing results and reconcile every ID.
Isolate parallel edits in worktrees and verify globally after integration.
example: Audit three independent route groups, then reconcile every route and reproduce findings.
diagram:
flowchart TD
  K[Known inventory] --> A[Unit A]
  K --> B[Unit B]
  K --> C[Unit C]
  A --> R[Reconcile all IDs]
  B --> R
  C --> R
  R --> V[Global acceptance]
